ops.title: Local knowledge-graph memory layer over cc-notes activity
ops.description:
Umbrella for the nine-phase plan in doc `3d9c793` ("Knowledge-graph memory layer: approved execution plan"). Decisions fixed up front are in note `acd2aac`.

Ship criterion for the whole epic is not "the graph exists" — it is that the graph **beats a full-context dump and plain BM25** on the Phase 5 eval. If it does not, the honest outcome is to ship the threading pass plus a lexical ranker and delete the rest.

ops.text: Phase 5 eval shows the graph ranker beating both the full-context and BM25 baselines across >=5 seeds
cc-notes search "rust build" in ~/Code/monorepo returns the relevant buck2/cargo-workspace notes (today: zero results)
Every read path produces a correct answer with the daemon stopped and the network denied
CGO_ENABLED=0 go build ./... succeeds from a fresh clone with no Rust toolchain
